title: [29.x ]Trial Balance (Excel) report shows incorrect figures and formatting differences compared to Trial Balance (Obsolete) report in Business Central v28.2
summary: Trial Balance Excel reports now correctly apply global dimension filters (Department) when generating data, fixing incorrect figures that were appearing when dimension filters were combined with date filters.
key_points: Global Dimension 1 and 2 filters are now read from the G/L Account request record in the Trial Balance codeunit
Dimension filters are applied with SetFilter on the query dimension columns for both the ending-date and opening-balance passes
The standard, budget and consolidated Excel trial balance reports now offer the dimension filters as request filter fields, like the obsolete Trial Balance report
By-period and previous-year reports use a separate path and are not covered
Tests added for the dimension-filtered figures
